name: Koutari Tsukiko
source:
A pure Japanese lady from Kyoto.
She is skilled in flower arranging, tea ceremony, calligraphy and etiquette.

She is a proud but friendly Kyoto woman.

Her body is amazing when she takes off her clothes.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/soleil/itsudatsu/]official site[/url]]
